hypothesis: Training a full policy from differences between alternative multi-turn paths from the identical natural prefix can reduce opening and opponent variance without single-card teachers or shaped rewards.
initial_model: v1.4-r1; frozen engine, reference policy, 245 guarded actions, seven v14 snapshot seats; zero search
sample: Two independent arms. Four on-policy updates per arm, each 128 distinct natural seeds and four stochastic recruit continuations per seed. The same initial game, deterministic parent up to T7/8/9, shared environment seed and independent action draws. Temperature 0.75 for eligible T<=12 actions; parent greedy thereafter. Log all ranks and all non-forced sampled choices. Environment paths may diverge after actions change. No reward for hand generation, coin spend, or card identity.
fit: Relative advantage = terminal original rank utility minus mean of other three continuations. Full actor backbone, rank/value heads have no supervised loss. 2 fixed epochs, AdamW lr 1.2e-5, no weight decay, clip ratio 0.15, grad norm 0.5, minibatch 256, KL(reference||student) weight 0.08, eval-mode dropout. Adam carried across 4 updates. Check sampled vs recomputed initial log probabilities, actual native actions, source identity and engineering gates.
evaluation: Two prespecified final networks. Greedy T7-12 student with parent outside, 256 independent common v14hold games plus baseline. Apply D-128 growth, rank, utility and survival thresholds; a separate 512-seed panel is required if qualified. This is bounded method development; neither a formal long run nor a new protocol champion.
